address: Nieuwe Weteringstraat 16 / Weteringschans, Amsterdam (Prinsengracht-Weteringschans corner): 1981 dark-brick office block on a glazed undercroft, stepped to 27 m with copper details
notes: Nieuwe Weteringstraat 16 (BAG: built 1981; three office units and one other unit; 4,526 m2 footprint, 27.6 m): a dark-brick office block of the early 1980s on the Weteringschans (the former Universiteit Financiele Markten building). Three fronts are photographed: the canal-side south-west front (w02-217/w03-217, panorama 2017-07-07: a glazed undercroft on columns under a heavy concrete cantilever band, above it dark brown brick floors of deep-set windows with pale stone surrounds, stepped back in tiers with copper-clad roofs), the east front (w04-102, 2020-04-29: five floors of stone-surrounded windows over a colonnaded glass ground floor with a green copper stair tower) and the south front (w05-191, 2017-07-07).

Modelled: the south front (panel 261: 6 storeys), the canal front as two height groups (surface 77: 6 storeys; surface 75: 3 storeys) and the east front as two groups (surface 130: 6 storeys; surface 6: 4 storeys); dark brown brick with stone-grey window surrounds and a glazed ground storey under each. Copper roof as surveyed by 3DBAG LoD2.2.

Simplified: the heavy concrete cantilever bands, the colonnade of the undercroft and the green copper stair tower are not drawn (the ground is a glazed row; the tower is the 3DBAG wall and roof geometry in brick colour), the window hoods are plain deep reveals. Not modelled: the north street front (panel 10, 90 m; no panorama within 35 m) and the courtyard walls.
